note: Sources were found with the PubMed E-utilities MCP server. Every `set` entry names one PubMed-indexed article whose abstract reports the pathway being claimed; where the article reported something narrower than the entity's mechanism_summary, the label was narrowed to what the source actually shows rather than the other way round. A `noop` is a real answer: it records that the field was researched and nothing of an accepted source class supported a vocabulary label, so a rescan does not send anyone over the same ground.

source.title: Integrating network pharmacology and transcriptomics reveals the mechanism by which AS-IV prevents ethanol-induced acute gastric injury in rats

astragalus.rationale: Astragaloside IV, the principal characterised constituent of Astragalus membranaceus, inhibited the EGFR-driven PI3K/Akt/NF-κB axis and reduced oxidative-stress markers in rat gastric mucosa and GES-1 cells.

source.title: Adenylyl Cyclase Activator: Forskolin Mediates CREB ser133 Phosphorylation in the Hippocampus, Alleviates Autism-Like Deficits in a Valproic Acid Model of Wistar Rats

coleus-forskohlii.rationale: Forskolin, the diterpene Coleus forskohlii is standardised for, raised hippocampal CREB ser133 phosphorylation and reduced neuronal damage in the prefrontal cortex, hippocampus and cerebellum. The adenylyl-cyclase/cAMP step itself has no label in the vocabulary; the demonstrated downstream effect does.

source.title: Effects of Silexan on the serotonin-1A receptor and microstructure of the human brain: a randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind, cross-over study with molecular and structural neuroimaging

lavandula-angustifolia.rationale: Randomised placebo-controlled PET cross-over in 17 healthy men: 160 mg/day Silexan, an essential oil from Lavandula angustifolia flowers, significantly reduced 5-HT1A receptor binding potential in temporal, fusiform, hippocampal, insular and anterior cingulate clusters. The study reports receptor-level engagement, not a clinical outcome.

source.title: Three new cyathane diterpenes with neurotrophic activity from the liquid cultures of Hericium erinaceus

hericium-erinaceus.rationale: Cyathane diterpenes isolated from H. erinaceus liquid culture promoted neurite outgrowth in PC12 cells at 2.5-10 μM.

source.title: Nrf-2 mediated heme oxygenase-1 expression, an antioxidant-independent mechanism, contributes to anti-atherogenesis and vascular protective effects of Ginkgo biloba extract

ginkgo-biloba.rationale: Ginkgo biloba extract activated Nrf2 translocation and ARE binding, induced HO-1, and reduced cytokine-induced endothelial adhesiveness in human aortic endothelial cells and injured arteries in vivo. Antioxidant is deliberately NOT claimed: the paper's own finding is that the effect is antioxidant-independent and PEG-SOD did not alter it.

source.title: Apigenin, a component of Matricaria recutita flowers, is a central benzodiazepine receptors-ligand with anxiolytic effects

matricaria-chamomilla.rationale: Apigenin, isolated from the aqueous extract of M. recutita flower heads, competitively inhibited flunitrazepam binding at the central benzodiazepine site of the GABA-A receptor (Ki 4 μM) and was anxiolytic in the elevated plus-maze without sedation or myorelaxation at comparable doses.

electrolyte-mix.noop: Not a defined substance. `electrolyte-mix` is a category placeholder whose composition varies by product, so any pathway label would generalise across formulations the evidence does not match — prohibited by the pipeline's immutable invariants. The entity needs a composition before a mechanism can be attributed to it.

source.title: Antioxidant effects of different extracts from Melissa officinalis, Matricaria recutita and Cymbopogon citratus

lemongrass.rationale: Cymbopogon citratus extracts reduced brain lipid peroxidation (TBARS) induced by three different pro-oxidants and scavenged DPPH radicals. Melissa officinalis was the strongest of the three plants tested; the C. citratus effect is real but not the paper's headline.

source.title: Modification of the liver fatty acids by Hibiscus sabdariffa Linnaeus (Malvaceae) infusion, its possible effect on vascular reactivity in a metabolic syndrome model

hibiscus-sabdariffa.rationale: H. sabdariffa infusion altered the hepatic fatty-acid profile and desaturase activity in metabolic-syndrome rats and improved the impaired vascular reactivity that accompanied it.

source.title: Glycyrrhizic Acid Alleviates Atherosclerosis in Mice via Microbial Indole-3-Lactic Acid-Mediated AhR-p65 Interaction in the Endothelium

glycyrrhiza-glabra.rationale: Glycyrrhizic acid reversed gut dysbiosis and shifted microbial tryptophan metabolism; the resulting indole-3-lactic acid activated AhR, which bound NF-κB p65 and blocked its nuclear translocation, suppressing endothelial adhesion-molecule expression. Antibiotic depletion and faecal transplant established the microbiota dependence.

source.title: Differential inhibition of inflammatory effector functions by petasin, isopetasin and neopetasin in human eosinophils

butterbur.rationale: All three petasins from Petasites hybridus inhibited leukotriene synthesis in primed human eosinophils; petasin additionally prevented 5-lipoxygenase translocation to the nuclear envelope and blocked ECP release. The calcium effect is not claimed as Calcium-channel modulation: the authors attribute it to signalling at or proximal to PLCβ, not to channel block.

source.title: Role of 3-Acetyl-11-Keto-Beta-Boswellic Acid in Counteracting LPS-Induced Neuroinflammation via Modulation of miRNA-155

boswellia-serrata.rationale: AKBA, the boswellic acid Boswellia serrata gum resin is standardised for, lowered phosphorylated IκB-α (the NF-κB activation step) and carbonyl protein content in LPS-treated mice. 5-LO inhibition is stated as background in this paper rather than measured, so LOX inhibition is not claimed from it.

source.title: Anethole exerts antimetastatic activity via inhibition of matrix metalloproteinase 2/9 and AKT/mitogen-activated kinase/nuclear factor kappa B signaling pathways

fennel.rationale: Anethole, the principal constituent of fennel volatile oil, suppressed NF-κB phosphorylation alongside AKT, ERK and p38 in HT-1080 cells. Confidence is low because the evidence is for the isolated constituent in a tumour-cell model, not for a fennel preparation.

probiotic-strain-bifidobacterium.noop: Genus-level placeholder, not a strain. Probiotic effects are strain-specific and the pipeline's invariants forbid generalising across unmatched preparations, so no mechanism can be attributed to `Bifidobacterium` as such. The entity needs a named strain before this field can be filled.

source.title: Undenatured type II collagen for knee osteoarthritis

uc-ii-collagen.rationale: PRISMA-guided review of twelve pre-clinical and clinical UC-2 studies: the mechanism reported is oral tolerance, a specific immune-mediated route, with downstream reduction in joint inflammation.

source.title: The capsaicin receptor: a heat-activated ion channel in the pain pathway

capsicum-annuum.rationale: Expression cloning of the capsaicin receptor from sensory neurons: capsaicin, the pungent principle of Capsicum, selectively activates this non-selective cation channel of the TRP family. Metabolic Regulation, the entity's current mechanism_summary, is not claimed here — the retrievable thermogenesis evidence is in reviews rather than the primary literature this field accepts.

source.title: Effects of menthol on circular smooth muscle of human colon: analysis of the mechanism of action

peppermint.rationale: Menthol reduced spontaneous contractions of human distal colon circular muscle; nifedipine attenuated the effect and the response survived TRPM8 antagonism, neural blockade, guanylyl-cyclase inhibition and K+-channel block. TRPV1/TRPM8 activation, which the entity's mechanism_summary names, is specifically what this paper rules out as the spasmolytic route.

collagen-peptides.noop: The retrievable mechanistic literature on hydrolysed collagen peptides reports stimulation of type I procollagen expression in fibroblasts, which the canonical mechanism vocabulary has no label for; the entity's own mechanism_summary (Inflammatory Signaling Modulation) is not what that literature shows. Filling this needs an extracellular-matrix / collagen-synthesis mechanism in the taxonomy first.

beta-alanine.noop: Beta-alanine's mechanism is carnosine-mediated intracellular pH buffering in skeletal muscle. The canonical mechanism vocabulary has no label for acid-base buffering, and Metabolic regulation would describe it so loosely as to be useless for retrieval. Needs a vocabulary term, not a source.

probiotic-strain-lactobacillus.noop: Genus-level placeholder, not a strain — same reasoning as probiotic-strain-bifidobacterium. Probiotic mechanisms are strain-specific and cannot be attributed to `Lactobacillus` as a whole.

source.title: Stability of valeriana-type iridoid glycosides from rhizomes of Nardostachys jatamansi and their protection against H2O2-induced oxidative stress in SH-SY5Y cells

jatamansi.rationale: Crude extracts, solvent partitions and isolated valeriana-type iridoid glycosides from N. jatamansi rhizome all protected SH-SY5Y neuroblastoma cells against hydrogen-peroxide toxicity on viability and antioxidation assays.

peppermint-oil.shared_value_acknowledged: Same value as `peppermint`, from the same source. Peppermint oil is the preparation the menthol evidence was generated from, so the mechanism is identical by construction; the two entities are a whole-herb / preparation split, not a duplicate.

source.title: Effects of menthol on circular smooth muscle of human colon: analysis of the mechanism of action

peppermint-oil.rationale: Menthol, the major constituent of peppermint oil, inhibited human colonic circular-muscle contractility through block of L-type Ca2+ influx; the effect was nifedipine-sensitive and TRPM8-independent.

source.title: Neuropharmacological evaluation on four traditional herbs used as nervine tonic and commonly available as Shankhpushpi in India
source.journal: Journal of Ayurveda and Integrative Medicine

shankhpushpi.rationale: All four botanicals sold as Shankhpushpi were assayed for acetylcholinesterase inhibition, antioxidant capacity and 5-LOX inhibition. Confidence is low deliberately: activity was strongly variety-dependent, with Evolvulus alsinoides clearly superior and Convolvulus pluricaulis among the weakest, and the trade name does not fix which species is in a given product.

source.title: Molecular mechanisms associated with macrophage activation by Rhizoma Atractylodis Macrocephalae polysaccharides

atractylodes.rationale: Total polysaccharides from Rhizoma Atractylodis Macrocephalae activated RAW 264.7 macrophages, raising NO, ROS, cytokine and chemokine output through NF-κB and JAK-STAT. NF-kB inhibition is explicitly NOT claimed: here NF-κB translocation is the activating event, the opposite direction.

agarikon.noop: The retrievable Fomitopsis officinalis literature is antimicrobial/antiviral and consists of reviews of highly variable crude-extract preparations. Antimicrobial activity has no label in the canonical mechanism vocabulary, and no primary mechanistic study of an accepted class was found.

source.title: HPLC based activity profiling for 5-lipoxygenase inhibitory activity in Isatis tinctoria leaf extracts

isatis.rationale: HPLC-based activity profiling of lipophilic Isatis tinctoria leaf extracts localised 5-lipoxygenase inhibition to two fractions — one coinciding with tryptanthrin, the major one with α-linolenic acid.

source.title: Hepatoprotective Potential of Eugenol Against Pesticide Glyphosate-Induced Liver Injury via Nrf2/HO-1 Signaling and Modulation of Apoptosis and Inflammation in Rats
source.journal: Journal of Biochemical and Molecular Toxicology

clove.rationale: Eugenol, the predominant constituent of clove oil (Syzygium aromaticum), activated Nrf2/HO-1 signalling, raised SOD and reduced glutathione, and suppressed COX-2, NF-κB, IL-6, TNF-α and IL-1β expression in glyphosate-exposed rat liver.

source.title: Galangin inhibits lipopolysaccharide-induced inflammation and stimulates osteogenic differentiation of bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells via regulation of AKT/mTOR signaling

galangal.rationale: Galangin, the flavonoid galangal is named for, lowered TNF-α, IL-1β and IL-6 in LPS-stimulated rat bone-marrow mesenchymal stem cells through down-regulation of NF-κB phosphorylation.

source.title: Rotenoids from Boerhaavia diffusa as potential anti-inflammatory agents

punarnava.rationale: Nine rotenoids isolated from Boerhaavia diffusa roots were assayed for COX-1 and COX-2 inhibition; boeravinone B was additionally anti-inflammatory in the carrageenan-induced rat paw model.

source.title: Houttuynia cordata water extract suppresses anaphylactic reaction and IgE-mediated allergic response by inhibiting multiple steps of FcepsilonRI signaling in mast cells

houttuynia.rationale: H. cordata water extract blocked antigen-induced degranulation (β-hexosaminidase, histamine) in IgE-sensitised RBL-2H3 mast cells, inhibited NF-κB activation and IκB-α degradation, and suppressed IL-4 and TNF-α, with in vivo confirmation in passive cutaneous anaphylaxis.

source.title: β-Lapachone suppresses neuroinflammation by modulating the expression of cytokines and matrix metalloproteinases in activated microglia

pau-d-arco.rationale: β-Lapachone, the naphthoquinone from the lapacho tree (Tabebuia / Handroanthus), inhibited NF-κB/AP-1 signalling and proinflammatory cytokine expression in LPS-stimulated microglia and raised HO-1 and NQO1 through the Nrf2/ARE pathway.

source.title: Anti-oxidative and anti-hyperglycemic properties of Agastache foeniculum essential oil and oily fraction in hyperglycemia-stimulated and lipopolysaccharide-stimulated macrophage cells

anise-hyssop.rationale: Agastache foeniculum essential oil and oily fraction lowered NADPH-oxidase activity and raised superoxide dismutase and catalase activity and expression in stimulated J774.A1 macrophages. Endocannabinoid modulation, which this entity's mechanism_summary claims, is not supported by this or any retrieved source.

source.title: A microdialysis study of effects of gastrodin on neurochemical changes in the ischemic/reperfused rat cerebral hippocampus

gastrodia.rationale: Hippocampal microdialysis in rats: gastrodin, from the rhizome of Gastrodia elata, blunted the ischaemia-induced rise in extracellular glutamate and increased extracellular GABA during reperfusion, lowering the glutamate/GABA ratio.

source.title: Pueraria mirifica phytoestrogens improve dyslipidemia in postmenopausal women probably by activating estrogen receptor subtypes

pueraria-mirifica.rationale: Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in 19 postmenopausal women showed HDL and apoA-1 rises and LDL and apoB falls; paired reporter-gene assays showed miroestrol and coumestrol enhance both ERα- and ERβ-mediated transactivation.

source.title: Anti-inflammatory Study on the Constituents of Angelica sinensis, Angelica dahurica, Angelica pubescens and Foeniculum vulgare Essential Oils

angelica-pubescens.rationale: In the TPA-induced mouse ear oedema model, Angelica pubescens essential oil (44.6% osthole) reduced TNF-α, COX-2, IL-6 and RelA/p65 levels in skin by immunohistochemistry.

source.title: AHR agonistic effects of 6-PN contribute to potential beneficial effects of Hops extract

hops.rationale: Hops extract and its prenylflavanones 8-PN and 6-PN showed estrogenic activity and activated ERα signalling in human endometrial cells. Stress Response Modulation, the entity's current mechanism_summary, is not what this source shows.

source.title: Preclinical evidence of rapid-onset antidepressant-like effect in Radix Polygalae extract

polygala.rationale: The antidepressant-like effect of Radix Polygalae in mice was blocked by the AMPA antagonist NBQX and accompanied by decreased hippocampal GluR1 ser845 phosphorylation, a ketamine-like glutamatergic signature. BDNF induction is cited from prior work rather than measured here, so it is not claimed.

source.title: New Lanostane-Type Triterpenes with Anti-Inflammatory Activity from the Epidermis of Wolfiporia cocos
source.journal: Journal of Agricultural and Food Chemistry

poria.rationale: Poricoic acid GM from the epidermis of Wolfiporia cocos suppressed IκB-α phosphorylation and NF-κB nuclear entry, blocked Keap1–Nrf2 dissociation to drive Nrf2 into the nucleus, and inhibited iNOS and COX-2 protein expression in LPS-induced RAW264.7 macrophages.

taurine-blend.noop: Not a defined substance. A blend has no fixed composition, so attributing a mechanism to it would generalise across formulations the evidence does not match.

source.title: Eucommia ulmoides leaf (EUL) extract enhances NO production in ox-LDL-treated human endothelial cells

eucommia.rationale: Eucommia ulmoides leaf aqueous extract and its iridoid aucubin restored nitric oxide levels, cut superoxide production and recovered phospho-eNOS Thr495 in ox-LDL-exposed HUVECs — that is, reversed eNOS uncoupling.

maral-root.noop: Rhaponticum carthamoides is described as adaptogenic in the retrieved literature, but the hits are phytochemistry and extraction-method papers that demonstrate no pharmacological mechanism. No primary study of an accepted class supported a vocabulary label.

source.title: Compound Danshen Dripping Pill ameliorates post ischemic myocardial inflammation through synergistically regulating MAPK, PI3K/AKT and PPAR signaling pathways

notoginseng.rationale: A dual-luciferase NF-κB reporter screen identified notoginsenoside R1, a saponin specific to Panax notoginseng, as one of four pivotal anti-inflammatory ingredients, with PI3K as its docked target. Confidence is low because the in vivo work is on the three-herb CDDP formula rather than on notoginseng alone.

source.title: 4-Hydroxyderricin and xanthoangelol from Ashitaba (Angelica keiskei) suppress differentiation of preadipocytes to adipocytes via AMPK and MAPK pathways

ashitaba-extract.rationale: The Ashitaba chalcones 4-hydroxyderricin and xanthoangelol promoted AMPK and acetyl-CoA-carboxylase phosphorylation in differentiating 3T3-L1 adipocytes, cut glycerol-3-phosphate acyltransferase-1 and raised carnitine palmitoyltransferase-1. PPAR activation is not claimed: PPAR-γ was down-expressed here.

ocotea-odorifera.noop: The retrievable Ocotea odorifera literature concerns its safrole-rich essential oil as an antibacterial and bacterial efflux-pump inhibitor. Neither antimicrobial action nor efflux-pump inhibition has a label in the canonical mechanism vocabulary.

probiotics.noop: Category placeholder covering every probiotic preparation. Probiotic mechanisms are strain-specific, so no mechanism can be attributed to probiotics as a class without generalising across unmatched preparations.

juniper.noop: The entity's mechanism_summary (digestive, urinary and aromatic support) has no counterpart in the canonical mechanism vocabulary, and the retrieved Juniperus communis hits are reviews of essential-oil constituents rather than primary mechanistic studies of an accepted class.

source.title: 1,8-Cineol inhibits nuclear translocation of NF-κB p65 and NF-κB-dependent transcriptional activity

eucalyptus.rationale: 1,8-Cineol (eucalyptol), the principal constituent of eucalyptus oil, reduced NF-κB p65 nuclear translocation and NF-κB-dependent transcription in LPS-stimulated human cell lines and in peripheral blood mononuclear cells, acting through IκB-α in an IKK-independent way.

milk-oats.noop: Researched and deliberately left empty. The best available human evidence for wild green oat (Avena sativa) extract is a 12-week randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled cross-over trial in 37 older adults that found no effect on any cognitive measure (PMID 22690320, doi 10.3390/nu4050331). No mechanistic study of an accepted class supported a vocabulary label, and a pathway label here would imply an activity the human evidence does not show.
